title: Party Time
content: We're about to launch into 2017. Why not party?We're all just refugees from a bygone era, doing our best to adapt to the demands of a new world. So let us bake a pie, play a tune, dance a jig, or paint a picture, because that's what we do.---Image fromDinotopia: Journey to Chandara,availablesigned from our USA web storeoron Amazon.LinkologyInstagram @jamesgurneyartTwitter @GurneyJourneyFacebook JamesMGurneyiOS app GurneyJourney BlogPinterest GurneyJourneyYouTube GurneyJourney
